title: When mercy feels hard to receive under pressure
issueStatement: The heart keeps assuming kindness must first be earned. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru keeps mercy close to gift, nearness, and return. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Receive the day as given, then answer it with Naam. Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review.
actionPrompt: Receive one line as mercy before turning it into a performance review. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
